subject: cult-af-bs
title: CULT.AF.BS.------STF.
description: Second diagram on page 30 (BK(NM)-6), paired with CRTF-PROG × TR above. The crossing diagrams how culture affinity basis structurally meets source-transfer at the Spain/Italy black-Moors-and-classical-music transfer-cycle scale the following prose names ('the progressional expansion of classical music can be viewed as moving northward from the region of Spain and later Italy'): CULT-AF-BS (culture affinity basis) crossed with STF (source transfer). CULT-AF-BS sits at upper-right with the subject-arrow; STF at center-bottom as partner-axis. TRS (transition) branches from the main line to the top-center, with AF-DY (affinity dynamics) branching from TRS and BIA (bi-aitional) at upper-left from AF-DY. POL-CON (political consciousness) branches from the main line, with LANG-DY (language dynamics) branching from it and AFL (affinity alignment) and C-ACT (composite activism) from LANG-DY. T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) branches from the main line to the right, with INFO-DE(B) (information degrees, or information degree basis) branching from it and GRAD (gradualism) from INFO-DE(B).
